title: A ** next to other characters in a segment matches across slashes
prompt: In our picomatch, a double star only acts as a globstar when it is the whole path segment. When it sits next to other characters in the same segment, for example '**.thing.js' or '**.js', it should behave like a single star and must not match across path separators. Right now 'somepath/test.thing.js' wrongly matches '**.thing.js', and 'a/b/c.js' matches '**.js'. 'test.thing.js' should still match '**.thing.js' and 'somepath/test.thing.js' should still match '**/*.thing.js'. Please fix it.
